description: Sets up Cosend’s “Missed call text-back” automation on one WhatsApp number: When a customer calls your WhatsApp number and nobody picks up, they get a message from you straight away. Its settings are this recipe’s own, as its set-up form in Cosend asks them; a setting left out takes its default. It is set up switched off, and acts only once it is switched on. The same recipe is set up once on each number, or once per source when it asks for one. The preview refuses a second one as the save would, and gives no token. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the automation, switched off.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) this automation belongs to: its triggers come from it, its messages go from it, and its templates are read on it. Required, and it cannot be moved afterwards. The same recipe (slug) can be set up once on each number, or once per source on it when the recipe has `multiple`.

name.description: Its name in Cosend. Left out, it takes the recipe’s name.

settings.description: The recipe’s settings, as its set-up form asks them. A setting left out takes its default; a setting with no default is needed.

closed_message.default: Sorry we missed your call. We are closed right now and will reply when we open.
closed_message.description: Sent instead when the call comes outside your opening hours.
closed_message.title: Your message while you are closed

message.default: Sorry we missed your call. How can we help?
message.description: Sent on WhatsApp to a customer whose call nobody answered.
message.title: Your message while you are open

weekly_hours.description: Each open day with its own opening and closing time, for example Saturday 09:00 to 14:00. A day not listed is closed. Left empty, the hours above apply on each open day.
weekly_hours.title: Opening hours per day

name: set_up_missed_call_text_back
title: Set up “Missed call text-back”
